ideas.title: Build a Flood Farm 🌊
ideas.hook: Your farm sits on a beach where the tide rises every few minutes. Build terraces higher, plant smarter, and harvest before the wave hits.
core_loop: Plant crops on your terraced plot
Harvest and sell before the flood timer runs out
Spend cash on higher terraces, walls and pumps
Flood-soaked crops can mutate into rare water strains
Unlock bigger waves that pay more
ideas.twist: The flood is the mutation engine: crops that survive a wave on a low terrace come back as rare 'tide' variants, so you gamble low ground for rarer harvests.
ideas.why_now: Grow × Disaster is the top gap in the data (score 7.45, still thin). Grow / farm is rising at 1.72 momentum (49 new games, 116,857 CCU) led by [🐜] Ant Evolution (23,577) and Throw a Seed (15,547), and Disaster / weather is at 2.93 with Stop The Tsunami! (15,489). The "Build a ___" title formula is at 1.27 (Build Your World! 🔨, 16,033).
ideas.differentiator: Farming games protect crops from nothing; here the disaster is both the timer and the source of rare mutations.

ideas.title: Draw Arms for Mechs 🦾
ideas.hook: Sketch your mech's arms on a canvas: long and thin, huge and clubby, spiky. The drawing becomes a physics limb and you punch other mechs off the platform.
core_loop: Draw two arms in 20 seconds
Your mech spawns with those exact shapes as physics limbs
Swing and smash rivals in a ragdoll arena
Win scrap to unlock new materials (steel, rubber, magnet)
Climb the ranked ladder
ideas.twist: Shape is the stat: weight, reach and spin come from what you drew, so a funny scribble can beat a careful one.
retention: Weekly draw challenge (only circles, only lines)
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is rising at 1.76 (32 new games) and Paint × Robots / mechs is the second-biggest gap (score 4.45). Robots / mechs is at 1.82 (Mechs vs Kaiju's Ragdoll | [DRILL UPDATE], 5,907) and Hit / swing / launch at 1.77, while the Fight × Hit pair has 9 new games with 207,018 CCU (Realistic Ragdoll MMA 🥊, 23,859).
ideas.differentiator: Mech games give you preset parts; here every arm is drawn by the player and behaves like it looks.

ideas.title: Escape the Convoy 🪖
ideas.hook: Two players steal a jeep from an army base. One drives, one shoots. Get through the checkpoints before the convoy boxes you in.
core_loop: Pair up: driver and gunner
Break out of the base and pick a road
Shoot tyres and dodge roadblocks while the convoy chases
Reach the border to bank cash
Upgrade the jeep and unlock longer routes
ideas.twist: Roles swap at every checkpoint, so both players have to be able to drive and shoot.
ideas.why_now: Escape × Military is a top gap (score 3.84). Race × Shooter is the second-hottest pair (6 new games, 227,589 CCU). Military is rising at 1.58 (Voxel Wars, 20,258), Escape / run at 1.38 (13 Days to Escape [ALPHA], 12,470) and Realistic art at 1.71 (BloxNG [CRASH PHYSICS] 💥, 30,948).
ideas.differentiator: Escape games are on foot and solo; this is a two-seat car chase where the passenger fights back.

ideas.title: Plow Zombies for Scrap 🧟
ideas.hook: Bolt a plow to your truck and drive straight through the horde. Every zombie and wreck you smash drops scrap for a bigger plow.
core_loop: Drive into a zombie-filled road
Smash zombies, barricades and wrecks for scrap
Bank scrap at the safehouse
Upgrade plow, armour and engine
Push into the next, thicker zone
ideas.twist: Zombies pile up on the plow blade, so you have to shake or ram them off before the weight stalls you.
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig has the highest mechanic momentum at 1.94 (46 new games, Sandworm Playground 17,466), and Break × Zombies is an open, thin gap (score 2.66). The Break × Race pair has 5 new games with 182,978 CCU, and Race / drive is rising at 1.57 (BloxNG [CRASH PHYSICS] 💥, 30,948).
ideas.differentiator: Zombie games are about surviving the horde; here the horde is the ore you mine with a truck.

ideas.title: Be a Kart Polo Pro 🏑
ideas.hook: Drive a go-kart, swing a giant mallet, smack the ball into the goal. Short 3v3 matches with ragdoll crashes.
core_loop: Queue into a 3v3 match
Drive and swing to hit the ball
Score goals and knock rivals off their karts
Earn coins to unlock karts and mallets
Climb the season ladder
ideas.twist: Hitting another kart with the mallet ragdolls the driver out for 3 seconds, so defence is a valid play.
monetization: Luck pass for rare mallet crates
ideas.why_now: Hit × Race is the strongest pair in the data (7 new games, 238,321 CCU). Hit / swing / launch is rising at 1.77 and Race / drive at 1.57; Sports is at 1.18 with Ragdoll Soccer (25,022). The "Be a ___" formula is at 1.38 (⚽ Be a Soccer Legend, 10,565).
inspired_by: Can You Pass A Driving Test?
ideas.differentiator: Ragdoll sports games are on foot; adding karts and a swing gives speed and a second skill.

ideas.title: Be a Bouncer 🚪
ideas.hook: Work the door of a packed club. Check who gets in and physically throw troublemakers out into the street.
core_loop: Check guests in the line (dress code, list, fake names)
Throw out the ones who cause trouble with ragdoll grabs
Get paid per shift and tips for clean nights
Unlock bigger venues and harder crowds
Buy outfits and throw moves
ideas.twist: Other players can join as guests and try to sneak in or start trouble, so every shift has real people to deal with.
ideas.why_now: Fight × Hit is a top pair (9 new games, 207,018 CCU) led by Realistic Ragdoll MMA 🥊 (23,859, 13 days old). Hit / swing / launch is at 1.77, Fight / battle jumped 0.48 this week to 1.21, and Interior maps are rising at 1.73 (DONT SPLASH, 24,900). "Be a ___" is at 1.38.
ideas.differentiator: Ragdoll games are free-for-all; here the throwing is a job with rules, a line, and players on both sides of the door.

ideas.title: Shrink Giants for Gems 🔫
ideas.hook: Huge giants stomp into the arena. Shoot them with shrink rays until they're tiny, then punt them for gems.
core_loop: Join a round as a giant walks in
Shoot shrink rays to cut its size
Finish it off when it's small enough to kick
Collect gems by size tier
Upgrade rays and unlock bigger giants
ideas.twist: Shots can hit other players too, so you can shrink a rival and steal the final kick.
ideas.why_now: Giant / huge is rising at 2.70 (29 new games, 250,370 CCU) with [⚡ UPD 2] Be The Biggest Streamer (11,486), and Shooter at 1.68 (Ragdoll Physics 🩸, 27,367). Fight × Shooter is a top pair (7 new games, 202,575 CCU). Arena maps are at 1.64 and the "___ for ___" formula at 1.13 (Jump for Cases🎲, 8,819).
inspired_by: [✨ NEW ZONES] Summon a Pet Army 🐲
ideas.differentiator: Giant games make you big; here the giants are the targets and shrinking them is the reward loop.

ideas.title: +1 Barrel Per Shot 🔫
ideas.hook: Every shot you fire adds one more barrel to your gun. Start with a pistol, end with a 500-barrel monster that fills the screen.
core_loop: Fire at targets to get +1 barrel
Bigger guns clear tougher target zones
Earn cash to buy fire-rate and spread upgrades
Unlock the next zone
Rebirth to keep a barrel multiplier
ideas.twist: Barrels are visible and physical: a huge gun is slow to turn, so players have to balance size against aim.
ideas.why_now: The "+1 ___" title formula is the strongest formula at 1.79 (35 new games, 91,044 CCU) and +1 stat per action is at 1.75, led by [🌍UPD 5] +1 Venom Evolution (12,837) and +1 Boxing Battle Evolution (11,811). Shooter is rising at 1.68 ([FPS] Pixel Arena, 10,090) and Military at 1.58 (Voxel Wars, 20,258).
ideas.differentiator: +1 games grow your body or a number; here the stat is the gun itself, and its size changes how you play.

ideas.title: Wreck Tanks for Medals 🪖
ideas.hook: Grab a sledgehammer and take apart army tanks piece by piece. Tracks, turrets and armour plates all fly off with real physics.
core_loop: Pick a tank on the scrapyard field
Smash it apart with hammers, wrecking balls and rams
Each part broken pays medals
Buy heavier tools
Unlock jets, bunkers and battleships to wreck
ideas.twist: Parts you knock off can be swung as weapons, so a torn-off turret barrel becomes your next bat.
monetization: Luck pass for rare tank drops
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig leads all mechanics at 1.94 and Hit / swing / launch is at 1.77; the Break × Hit pair has 6 new games with 181,408 CCU. Military is rising at 1.58 (Voxel Wars, 20,258), Realistic art at 1.71, and the Physics Sim sub-genre at 2.96 (Hyper Realistic Ragdoll, 174,338).
ideas.differentiator: Destruction games break cars; this breaks military vehicles and turns their parts into new tools.

ideas.title: Brawl for Oxygen 🚀
ideas.hook: A space station is losing air. Everyone floats in zero gravity, punching and shoving each other to grab the last oxygen tanks.
core_loop: Spawn on a leaking station with an oxygen meter
Fight in zero-g to grab tanks
Push rivals out of the airlock
Last one breathing wins the round
Spend stars on suits and thrusters
ideas.twist: Every punch sends both players flying the opposite way, so fights double as movement.
ideas.why_now: Space is rising at 2.92 ([🛸] Sweep The Moon 🌕, 10,800; [PHYSICS] Ragdoll Playground, 8,178) and Physics Sim at 2.96 (Hyper Realistic Ragdoll, 174,338). Fight / battle is up 0.48 this week to 1.21, Hit / swing / launch is at 1.77, and Interior maps are at 1.73. "___ for ___" is at 1.13 (Hike For Eggs, 7,955).
ideas.differentiator: Ragdoll brawlers use gravity; zero-g makes every hit a launch and the air supply a round timer.
